The task of fixing a dripping kitchen tap can be a common household repair that requires some basic tools and know-how. Start by turning off the water supply to the tap to prevent any further leakage. Next, use a wrench to carefully disassemble the tap, taking note of the order of the parts for reassembly. Once everything is back in place, turn the water supply back on and test the tap to ensure the leak has been fixed.
